result.title: MG-Cache: Multi-Granularity Caching for Accelerating Diffusion Transformer Inference
result.summary: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models, while having become a powerful backbone for generative synthesis, suffer from high inference cost on generating high-resolution images. Diffusion caching has emerged as a promising acceleration technique to reduce inference cost. However, existing caching strategies fail to accurately identify the varying importance of different computational modules and rarely coordinate cache reusing across the timestep and layer granularities, making it difficult to control error accumulation. To address these limitations, we propose multi-granularity caching (MG-Cache) for DiTs, a novel and fully training-free approach to exploit computational redundancy both on timesteps and Transformer layers. Our core innovation contains a two-stage caching strategy: an offline timestep profiling analysis that identifies redundant timesteps for cache reuse, followed by an adaptive layer-wise caching strategy that combines input stability with importance of each Transformer layer to selectively cache stable Attention and MLP submodules. Extensive experiments on mainstream open-source DiT models validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving significant acceleration while maintaining high fidelity to the uncached output, with up to a 4.18x acceleration on HunyuanVideo.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MG-Cache，一种免训练的扩散 Transformer 推理加速方法，通过离线时间步画像与自适应层粒度缓存，复用稳定的 Attention/MLP 子模块计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向图像/视频生成的去噪过程加速，只优化计算复用与输出保真，不涉及推理状态生成、视觉证据获取或答案使用，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的实质联系。
